meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & José Areán, Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode, Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas, Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
